notes.title: Servers Now Open! - Go And Login!
notes.content:
[u][b]Servers are now open!!![/b][/u]

This marks our [b]3rd[/b] multiplayer playtest for FreeJack Online!

We've got loads of new content for you to try out, such as [b]talents[/b], [b]trick updates[/b] and [b]perfect dashes[/b]. 

You'll also be able to immerse yourselves in the brand new [b]visual update[/b]!

You'll find the full list of updates in the news tab in the main menu or on the latest patch notes on the Steam page.

[u][b]Servers close in 2 weeks on Monday 3rd June[/b][/u]

[i]"Listen closely, young runner," the sensei whispers, his voice carrying the quiet force of the city's heartbeat. "Each flawless movement in our world channels your focus, that vital energy, bringing you closer to what the streets call 'Max Booster'—a state of flow where every limit is merely a challenge waiting to be transcended."[/i]

notes.title: Public Playtest Incoming!
notes.content:
This two-week event will serve as an opportunity to iron out any bugs or issues that may arise from the upgrades to the multiplayer and game engine. As a token of our appreciation, we will be offering exciting prizes and other goodies to participants.

Secondly, we extend our heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you who participated in our last public playtest. Your engagement has been nothing short of inspiring, with over 1600 daily active users immersing themselves in the world of FreeJack. This overwhelming support has led to the creation of over 6500 unique game accounts — a testament to the vibrant community we've built together. We are deeply encouraged by these numbers and immensely proud of the results we've achieved together!

Make sure to join our Discord if you want to have a chat with the devs or other community members :)

See you on the circuit!

notes.title: Open Beta Is Live!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Runners,[/b]

We are thrilled to announce that the servers are now officially live! The wait is over, and we invite you to dive into our public play test that we've worked hard to create for you. To show our appreciation for your enthusiasm and support, we're extending the excitement by keeping the servers up and running for a 48 hours. This gives you ample time to explore the the newest additions and changes to the game! 

So, gear up, embark on your races, and make the most of the next 48 hours of uninterrupted gaming. We hope you thoroughly enjoy your time while playing FreeJack and don't forget to leave feedback in our Discord or report any bugs that you may find.

notes.title: Officially on Steam
notes.content:
It's official. We're now on Steam. How exciting! So go and smash that wishlist if you're as excited as we are. Every bit of exposure helps and we're now at that stage where we need your support.

Please take the time to spread the news about our upcoming play test with friends, streamers, and anyone that may happen to find that spark of interest in FreeJack; it's this type of community engagement that we need to drive this project into full-blown execution.

Reminder that the next open beta will be exclusively on Steam, servers will go live November 18, 2023, at 00:00 UTC, so clear your calendars for that!

It goes without saying that we couldn't have made it this far in the game without your interest in our work. It's our greatest pleasure to once again have the experience of playing alongside each and every one of you at the open beta play test.

See you on the racing grounds.

Best Regards,
- Team FreeJack
